label: Machine F: chiral irreversible — completing the 2x3 classification
motivation: Pass 4344 identified Machine F (chiral irreversible) as the missing cell. Pass 4345 proved CHIRAL_GATE is reversible. Machine F must be constructed differently: chiral but with at least one irreversible (non-bijective) opcode.

construction.strategy: Take Machine B (symmetric irreversible) and replace 1 symmetric opcode with the chiral orientation-reversing map. The orientation reversal is not a bijection on flag-level state space (it collapses 3 flags to 1 per depth shell).

chiral_irreversible_opcode.name: FOLD_CHIRAL
chiral_irreversible_opcode.action: Projects all 3 flags in one depth-4 shell to the lexicographically minimal flag. Irreversible: 3-to-1 collapse. Chiral: the collapse direction depends on orientation of the shell.

full_2x3_classification.open_question_resolved: Machine F exists and is constructible from Machine B by FOLD_CHIRAL substitution.
